objectives.title: Domain Admin
objectives.prompt: Compromise the change.me domain, reach Domain Admin and read C:\ctf\flag.txt on dc01.
hints: Start without credentials: anonymous LDAP and a public SMB share give the first leads.
With one account, spray passwords and look at which accounts can be roasted.
Chain the ACLs you find (BloodHound) towards an account with replication rights or Domain Admins.
